# CloudBase Bridge

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**GitHub**: [github.com/DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge](https://github.com/DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge)

Bring the AI quota of Tencent CloudBase's "小程序成长计划" (mini-program growth plan) into [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) as an ordinary OpenAI-compatible provider, through an `aiProxy` cloud function you deploy yourself. Once set up, it's just another provider on your account that any agent can use.

> Community project: not affiliated with Magpie or Tencent Cloud, and not reviewed or curated by Magpie.

![Growth-plan gift quota in the CloudBase console: 1B tokens + 100K image generations](docs/images/growth-plan-quota.png)

## Why a cloud function in the middle?

The gift quota only pays out on CloudBase SDK channels — calling the `/v1/ai/*` model endpoints directly is rejected (`403 AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`). So the plugin never talks to those endpoints. It calls your `aiProxy` cloud function through the official function-invocation endpoint, and the function calls the model with `@cloudbase/node-sdk`, which is allowed:

```
Agent ─► magpie gateway ─► plugin ── POST /v1/functions/aiProxy ──► aiProxy (your env) ── SDK ──► model
```

The function returns one complete result; the plugin reshapes it into OpenAI Chat Completions, and synthesizes SSE locally when the agent asked to stream.

## Models

| Model ID | Context |
| --- | --- |
| `hy3` | 256K |
| `hy4` | 1M |
| `hy4-preview` | 1M |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 1M |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` | 1M |

No console opt-in needed; usage is deducted from the gift pack automatically. Availability can vary per environment — if CloudBase answers `AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED`, go by what your environment actually supports.

## What you need

1. A CloudBase environment with the growth plan (or an active Token Credits pack);
2. the `aiProxy` function deployed in that environment (next section);
3. a server-side API Key, created in the console under Environment settings → API Key.

> The API Key carries full admin rights over the environment. It lives only in Magpie's local auth store (`~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json`, mode 600) — don't commit it anywhere or hand it to anyone.

## Deploy aiProxy

Full steps (console upload, CLI, common pitfalls) live in [`cloudfunctions/aiProxy/README.md`](cloudfunctions/aiProxy/README.md). Quick CLI version:

```bash
cp cloudbaserc.example.json cloudbaserc.json   # set envId to yours
tcb login
tcb fn deploy aiProxy --force
tcb fn invoke aiProxy --params '{"action":"ping"}'   # expect {"ok":true,...}
```

Key points: a normal Event Function (not an HTTP function), Nodejs18.15 or newer, timeout 120 s, cloud dependency install enabled. No need to configure the environment id — the runtime injects `TCB_ENV` automatically. To add or remove models, set the function's `AI_PROXY_ALLOWED_MODELS` env var (comma-separated).

## Install & login

```bash
magpie plugin add DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge   # or: the npm package opencode-cloudbase-bridge, or ./cloudbase-bridge for a local checkout
magpie plugin login cloudbase
```

Login walks you through the API Key, the environment ID, the region (mainland China / international), and the function name (press Enter to keep `aiProxy`). Models then appear as `cloudbase/hy3`, `cloudbase/hy4-preview`, and so on (if the `cloudbase` id is already taken, Magpie renames the provider to `cloudbase-plugin` — both prefixes work). Which models an account actually gets is decided by your deployed function's allowlist; the plugin queries it after login.

Sign out with `magpie plugin logout cloudbase`.

## Try it in a sandbox first

None of this touches your real magpie config or logins:

```bash
sb=$(mktemp -d)
m() { env HOME=$sb XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$sb/.config XDG_CACHE_HOME=$sb/.cache MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie "$@"; }
m plugin add ./cloudbase-bridge </dev/null
m plugin login cloudbase
m provider test cloudbase        # or a single model: m provider test cloudbase hy3
```

No CloudBase environment yet? Walk the flow against the bundled mock gateway:

```bash
node scripts/mock-ai-proxy.mjs --port 8787
m plugin options cloudbase-bridge '{"gatewayBaseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:8787"}'
```

`gatewayBaseUrl` is for testing only — it sends every request, including the API Key header, to that URL. Clear it afterwards with `m plugin options cloudbase-bridge off`.

## Options

| Option | What it does | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `envId` / `region` / `functionName` | fallbacks beyond the login answers (handy under plain OpenCode, where the login prompts may not render) | — / `cn` / `aiProxy` |
| `timeoutMs` | how long one function invocation may take | 150000 |
| `gatewayBaseUrl` | testing-only gateway URL override | unset |

## When something goes wrong

Errors come back as OpenAI-style `{ error: { message, code } }`, and the message usually says what happened. The common ones: `FUNCTIONS_NOT_FOUND` (function not deployed, or wrong environment), `AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED` (the function must call the model via the Node SDK), `AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED` (model not available in your environment), 401 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (wrong or wrong-type API Key), timeouts, and `EXCEED_TOKEN_QUOTA_LIMIT` (quota spent or expired). Fixes for each are in [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md).

## Known limitations

- No true streaming: the upstream reply is one-shot, SSE is synthesized locally, so the first token only arrives when generation finishes;
- no tool calling, no image input, and `max_tokens` is ignored (the SDK channel takes `{ model, messages, temperature, topP }` only);
- very long outputs can hit the function's 120 s timeout;
- no quota reporting (no official API for it); the gift quota itself expires (6 months).

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run check     # typecheck + build + 34 unit tests + host-like load check — no network, no real credentials
```

Publishing and listing steps are in [`docs/publish-checklist.md`](docs/publish-checklist.md).

# CloudBase Bridge

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**GitHub**：[github.com/DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge](https://github.com/DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge)

通过你自己部署的 `aiProxy` 云函数，把腾讯云开发 CloudBase「小程序成长计划」的 AI 额度接入 [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai)，作为普通的 OpenAI 兼容供应商使用。装好之后，它就是你账号下的一个普通供应商，各个 agent 都能直接用。

> 社区项目：和 Magpie、腾讯云都没有关系，也没有经过 Magpie 官方审核或收录。

![「小程序成长计划」赠送额度：10 亿 Token + 10 万张生图（云开发控制台截图）](docs/images/growth-plan-quota.png)

## 为什么要经过一个云函数？

成长计划送的额度只认 CloudBase SDK 这条通道，直接去调 `/v1/ai/*` 模型端点会被拒（`403 AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`）。所以这个插件不直连模型，而是走官方的函数调用端点，让你环境里的 `aiProxy` 云函数用 `@cloudbase/node-sdk` 去调模型——这条路是允许的：

```
Agent ─► magpie 网关 ─► 插件 ── POST /v1/functions/aiProxy ──► aiProxy（你的环境）── SDK ──► 模型
```

云函数一次性返回完整结果，插件把它整理成 OpenAI Chat Completions 格式；agent 要流式输出时，插件在本地合成 SSE。

## 模型

| 模型 ID | 上下文长度 |
| --- | --- |
| `hy3` | 256K |
| `hy4` | 1M |
| `hy4-preview` | 1M |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 1M |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` | 1M |

这些模型不用在控制台开启，用量会自动从赠送额度里扣。个别模型在部分环境不一定放开——如果 CloudBase 返回 `AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED`，以你环境的实际支持为准。

## 准备工作

1. 一个开通了成长计划（或买了 Token 资源包）的 CloudBase 环境；
2. 在这个环境里部署 `aiProxy` 云函数（见下一节）；
3. 一个服务端 API Key：在控制台「环境设置 → API Key」创建。

> API Key 是整个环境的最高权限凭证，只保存在你本机的 Magpie 认证存储里（`~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json`，权限 600），不要写进任何文件或交给别人。

## 部署 aiProxy

完整步骤（控制台上传、CLI、常见坑）见 [`cloudfunctions/aiProxy/README.md`](cloudfunctions/aiProxy/README.md)。命令行快速版：

```bash
cp cloudbaserc.example.json cloudbaserc.json   # 把 envId 改成你的
tcb login
tcb fn deploy aiProxy --force
tcb fn invoke aiProxy --params '{"action":"ping"}'   # 应返回 {"ok":true,...}
```

几个要点：普通事件函数（不是 HTTP 函数）、Nodejs18.15 及以上、超时设 120 秒、开云端安装依赖。环境 ID 不用配，运行时会自动注入 `TCB_ENV`；想增减模型就改函数的环境变量 `AI_PROXY_ALLOWED_MODELS`（逗号分隔）。

## 安装和登录

```bash
magpie plugin add DaBinBinah/cloudbase-bridge   # 也可：npm 包 opencode-cloudbase-bridge，或 ./cloudbase-bridge 本地加载
magpie plugin login cloudbase
```

登录时会依次问：API Key、环境 ID、区域（中国大陆 / 国际站）、云函数名（直接回车就是 `aiProxy`）。之后模型就会出现在供应商列表里，名字是 `cloudbase/hy3`、`cloudbase/hy4-preview` 这样（如果 `cloudbase` 这个 id 被占了，Magpie 会自动改叫 `cloudbase-plugin`，两种前缀都能用）。每个账号实际可选哪些模型，以你部署的函数白名单为准——插件登录后会自动去问它。

登出：`magpie plugin logout cloudbase`。

## 先在沙盒里试试

不会碰你正在用的 magpie 配置和登录信息：

```bash
sb=$(mktemp -d)
m() { env HOME=$sb XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$sb/.config XDG_CACHE_HOME=$sb/.cache MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie "$@"; }
m plugin add ./cloudbase-bridge </dev/null
m plugin login cloudbase
m provider test cloudbase        # 或只测一个模型：m provider test cloudbase hy3
```

还没有 CloudBase 环境？可以先对着仓库自带的 mock 网关把流程走一遍：

```bash
node scripts/mock-ai-proxy.mjs --port 8787
m plugin options cloudbase-bridge '{"gatewayBaseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:8787"}'
```

`gatewayBaseUrl` 只用于测试——它会把所有请求（包括 API Key 请求头）都发到这个地址。用完记得清掉：`m plugin options cloudbase-bridge off`。

## 可调的选项

| 选项 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `envId` / `region` / `functionName` | 登录信息之外的后备值（纯 OpenCode 环境下登录提问不一定有，可以用它兜底） | — / `cn` / `aiProxy` |
| `timeoutMs` | 单次调用云函数的最长等待 | 150000 |
| `gatewayBaseUrl` | 测试用的网关地址覆盖 | 不设置 |

## 出错了怎么办

错误会以 OpenAI 风格的 `{ error: { message, code } }` 返回，message 里通常已经写清原因。常见的几种：`FUNCTIONS_NOT_FOUND`（函数没部署或环境不对）、`AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`（函数必须走 Node SDK 调模型）、`AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED`（你的环境不支持这个模型）、401 `PERMISSION_DENIED`（API Key 不对或类型不对）、超时、`EXCEED_TOKEN_QUOTA_LIMIT`（额度用完或过期）。逐条的排查办法见 [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md)。

## 已知限制

- 没有真流式：上游是一次性返回，SSE 在本地合成，所以首 token 要等整段生成完；
- 不支持工具调用和图片输入，`max_tokens` 也会被忽略（SDK 通道只接受 `{ model, messages, temperature, topP }`）；
- 特别长的输出可能撞上云函数 120 秒超时；
- 没有额度展示（官方没给查询 API）；赠送额度本身有期限（6 个月）。

## 本地开发

```bash
npm install
npm run check     # 类型检查 + 构建 + 34 个单元测试 + 模拟宿主加载检查，全程不用网络和真实凭证
```

发布与收录的步骤见 [`docs/publish-checklist.md`](docs/publish-checklist.md)。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

# aiProxy — CloudBase Event Function

A normal (Event) CloudBase cloud function that calls CloudBase AI models via
`@cloudbase/node-sdk` and returns an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible JSON
reply. The **CloudBase Bridge** Magpie plugin invokes this function through
the official function-invocation HTTP endpoint, so **the function must be
deployed in the same CloudBase environment as the API Key you configure in
the plugin**, under the name **`aiProxy`** (or a custom name you also set
during plugin login).

Why a cloud function? The "小程序成长计划" (mini-program growth plan) AI
quota is only spendable from CloudBase SDK channels — direct calls to
`/v1/ai/*` model endpoints fail with `AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`. Inside a cloud
function the Node SDK channel is allowed and the gift quota is deducted
automatically.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Function entry: `exports.main(event, context)` |
| `package.json` | Declares `@cloudbase/node-sdk` (^3.16.0, required for AI features) |

## What it accepts

```jsonc
// event (the plugin builds this from the Chat Completions request)
{
  "action": "chat",            // or "ping" (returns ok/env/model list)
  "model": "hy3",
  "messages": [
    { "role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant." },
    { "role": "user", "content": "Hello" }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.7,          // optional, 0..2
  "topP": 0.9                  // optional, (0, 1]
}
```

Text-only: image parts and tool-call messages are rejected with a diagnostic
error (`IMAGE_INPUT_NOT_SUPPORTED` / `INVALID_REQUEST`) because the
documented `generateText` input carries plain string content.

## What it returns

Success — OpenAI Chat Completions JSON (this is the raw HTTP body; the
function-invocation API has no wrapper envelope):

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-…",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1762700000,
  "model": "hy3",
  "choices": [{ "index": 0, "message": { "role": "assistant", "content": "…" }, "finish_reason": "stop" }],
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 42, "total_tokens": 52 }
}
```

Failure — `{ "error": { "code": "…", "message": "…", "requestId": "…" } }`
with codes such as `INVALID_REQUEST`, `MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED`,
`AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED`, `AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED`,
`EXCEED_TOKEN_QUOTA_LIMIT`, `TCB_ENV_MISSING`, `UPSTREAM_ERROR`.

## Deploy — Option A: console (控制台上传)

1. Open <https://tcb.cloud.tencent.com>, select your environment.
2. **云函数 / Cloud Functions → 新建函数**:
   - Name: `aiProxy`
   - Runtime: **Nodejs18.15**（或更新；创建后运行时不可更改）
   - Function type: **事件函数 (Event Function)**
   - Memory: 256 MB, **Timeout: 120 s**（文本生成较慢，默认 20 s 不够）
3. Paste `index.js` as the entry (execution method `index.main`), and
   `package.json` alongside it. Enable **云端安装依赖 (installDependency)**
   so `@cloudbase/node-sdk` is installed by the platform, or zip the folder
   with `node_modules` included.
4. Environment variables: none required — **`TCB_ENV` is injected by the
   CloudBase runtime automatically**. Optionally set
   `AI_PROXY_ALLOWED_MODELS` (comma-separated model ids) to restrict or
   extend the allowlist; the default is
   `hy3,hy4,hy4-preview,deepseek-v4.1-flash,deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`
   (`deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` I verified in my own environment, though it
   is not in the official growth-plan notice; `hy4` is an unverified
   placeholder. CloudBase itself rejects ids it does not support with
   `AI_MODEL_NOT_SUPPORTED`).
5. Deploy, then verify with the console's inline test: invoke with
   `{"action":"ping"}` — expect `{"ok":true,"service":"aiProxy",...}`.

## Deploy — Option B: CLI (`tcb fn deploy`)

```bash
npm install -g @cloudbase/cli   # or: npm install -g @cloudbase/cli@latest
tcb login

# from the repository root
cp cloudbaserc.example.json cloudbaserc.json
# edit cloudbaserc.json: set envId to your environment id

tcb fn deploy aiProxy --force   # Event Function (no --httpFn)
tcb fn list                     # verify
tcb fn invoke aiProxy --params '{"action":"ping"}'
```

`installDependency: true` in the example config makes the platform install
`@cloudbase/node-sdk` from `package.json` (do **not** also upload
`node_modules`, they conflict).

## Security notes

- The function contains **no API Key and no environment id**. It trusts the
  CloudBase runtime (`TCB_ENV`) and authenticates to the model channel by
  the environment itself.
- Function invocation permissions are governed by **cloud function security
  rules + identity auth**. Admin identities (your server-side API Key)
  normally pass the default rule; if you see `EXCEED_AUTHORITY`, review the
  function security rules in the console
  (see `docs/troubleshooting.md`).
- Size limits: ≤128 messages, ≤200 000 chars per message, ≤400 000 chars
  total — keep agents from burning quota with runaway histories.
